'''''Koh-Lanta: Cambodge''''' is the twentieth season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. It was broadcast on TF1 from March 10 to June 16, 2017.

''Cambodge'' is notable for being the first season of ''Koh-Lanta'' to incorporate three starting tribes instead of two.

[[Frédéric Blancher]] defeated [[Clémentine Jullien]] in a 6-2 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]].

==Twists==
* '''Three [[Tribe|Tribes]]:''' For the first time in ''Koh-Lanta'' history, the game would start with three tribes instead of the usual two. A blue tribe, {{tribeicon|takeo20fr}}, is added to the traditional red and yellow tribes, {{tribeicon|bokor}} and {{tribeicon|sokka}}.
* '''[[Hidden Immunity Idol|Immunity Necklaces]]:''' A challenge is held at the marooning before the tribes were formed, where two Immunity Necklaces (the equivalent of Hidden Immunity Idols in ''Koh-Lanta'') would be up for grabs. After the [[merge]], two other Immunity Necklaces would be hidden at the merged tribe's [[camp]]. Also, for the first time, if a castaway is voted out with an Immunity Necklace in their possession, they can give it to a castaway still in the game.
* '''Jokers:''' On Day 4, three new castaways entered the game. The tribe that finished first in the [[Reward Challenge]] would get to choose which one would join them, the tribe that finished in second would choose among the two others, and the tribe that finished last gets the remaining castaway.
* '''[[Tribe Switch|Tribe Absorption]]:''' On Day 10, the tribe that lost the Reward Challenge would be dissolved. After the challenge, the two other tribes would send a diplomat to the losing tribe's camp, where they would have to choose which of its members would join their tribe in order to form two new tribes of nine.
* '''Confrontation:''' On Day 16, the two tribes are told to send one of their members to a confrontation. A [[duel]] would be held between the two chosen tribe members, with the winner giving an advantage to their tribe at the next [[Immunity Challenge]].
* '''Elimination Challenge:''' The members of the tribe that loses the Day 18 Reward Challenge would compete in an individual challenge the day after, where the person who finished in last would be directly eliminated from the game.
* '''[[Ambassadors]]:''' At the merge, each tribe sends an ambassador to a meeting. Their purpose is to directly eliminate a castaway from the game, and if the two ambassadors do not agree on a name, one of the two is eliminated by a rock draw. This season, like in {{S2|17fr}} and {{S2|18fr}}, the ambassadors would be chosen by the opposing tribe, without any diplomats being sent.
* '''Black Vote:''' The black vote would not be used during the pre-merge phase of the game, and would be re-introduced after the merge with different mechanics. At the first post-merge [[Tribal Council]], it was revealed that the castaways who had been voted out, from then on, would give a remaining castaway of their choice an [[Extra Vote]] at the following Tribal Council.
* '''Challenge Loss Penalty:''' On Day 28, a special challenge would be held, where the castaway who finished last would have an extra vote cast against them at the following Tribal Council, unless they won the subsequent [[Immunity Challenge]].
* '''[[Tied Destinies (twist)|Tied Destinies]]:''' On Day 30, the eight remaining castaways were divided into four pairs by a rock draw. Until the next Tribal Council, the fate of each castaway is linked to their partner: the challenges are competed as pairs, and the castaway voted out at Tribal Council also causes their partner's elimination.
